{{Quote|The old charts were a little vague once you got past Taanab.|Unattributed|<ref name="FF11">{{FactFile|11|PLA 7-8|Planets of the Inner Rim}}</ref>}}
The '''Inner Rim''', originally known as the '''Rim''', and also called the '''Inner Rim Planets''',<ref name="TRG2">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]]</ref> or the '''Inner Rim Territories''',<ref name="GSWU2">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> was a region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] between the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] and the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

The border of the Rim had thinner shape closer to the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], while it formed a bulge to the north-east side. This phenomenon originated from the time when the neighboring Expansion Region was being aggressively explored and exploited spinward of the Run impoverishing its worlds and native species. After ecological and financial catastrophies, these worlds were not settled, but settlement turned spinward and northwards instead.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
During the [[Pre-Republic era]], several worlds in the region including [[Denon/Legends|Denon]] and [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] were ruled by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] which contained various worlds across the Galaxy.<ref name="TEA" />

The Inner Rim was originally just called "the Rim" when discovered during the [[Expansionist Period/Legends|Expansionist Era]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was first settled by the Republic in [[20,100 BBY]] during the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]] and was expected to be the farthest extent of the known [[Galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]] for centuries. However, the Expanded Rim (later renamed the Expansion Region) was opened within a hundred years of the Inner Rim. Due to their closer proximity to the hub of galactic civilization in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], the Inner Rim was later included in the [[Greater Core]] and Inner Rimmers gradually developed a condescending attitude towards those of the "outer galaxy", ironically known as the [[Rim]] like the Inner Rim itself in ancient times. Conversely, Inner Rimmers flattered the high-ranked inhabitants of the Core and [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], but also resented them, as they were looked down upon them.<ref name="TEA" />

Between 5200 BBY to 4600 BBY, the jungle world of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] was settled by shipwrecked [[Human/Legends|human]] colonists who established a civilization centered on the city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]].<ref name="TEA" /> In [[4400 BBY]], the planet was taken over by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Freedon Nadd]] who established a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]] theocracy. The [[Naddist]]s expelled dissidents into the wilds of Onderon who established a new civilization known as the [[Beast Riders]]. In [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], a Jedi mission led by [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] teamed up with the Beast Riders to overthrow the Naddists; ending the centuries-long [[Beast Wars]].<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref>

In [[3996 BBY]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces invaded Onderon but were decimated by Republic reinforcements while their leader [[Mandalore the Indomitable]] met his demise on the jungle moon of [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]].<ref name="ToTJ:TSW">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 6]]</ref> For much of the [[Jedi Civil War]], the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] of Manaan maintained a state of neutrality and supplied the therapeutic [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] to both the Republic and [[Darth Malak]]'s [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]].<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> With the decline of the kolto market and the destruction of its surface cities during the [[Great Galactic War]], Manaan slipped into primitive decline.<ref name="MDH">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040205manaan1|series=Manaan: Depths of History|text=Part 1: Backwater}}</ref>

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], several Inner Rim worlds including the [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] homeworld of [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]] joined [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. The [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] homeworld of [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]] was the site of fighting between the pro-Republic [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Rangers]] and the Separatists. The fallout from the deployment of the [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulse]] weapon that incapacitated many Gotals prompted thousands of worlds to secede and join the Confederacy.<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Statute 312b|Fourth Constitutional Amendment]] gave Republic worlds in the Greater Core, which included the Inner Rim, more voting power than worlds in the Expansion Region and beyond.<ref name="TEA" />

In the subsequent decades the Inner Rim was a huge battlefront, with armies seeking to advance to the Core, and the Core trying to push them rimwards.<ref name="TEA" />

During the reign of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] ruthlessly controlled the Inner Rim. Rather than rebel, many residents chose to flee to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TNEC" /> After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] the Empire kept the region ruthlessly, looting the treasuries and supplies of the Inner Rimmers while youths were conscripted in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Military]]. Because the region was not culturally significant, it was not a priority for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republc]].<ref name="TEA" /> 

In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Cronal|Shadowspawn]] waged a [[Battle of Mindor|dogged and savage campaign]] against Republic forces on [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]], but failed.<ref name="TNEC" /> In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] was the site of fighting between [[Ysanne Isard]]'s Imperial faction and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] over control of the production and supply of therapeutic [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]].<ref name="TEC" /> Due to the entrenched Imperial presence, much of the region was held by the Empire until as late as [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. Subsequently, many Inner Rimmers later resented the New Republic's sluggishness in liberating the region. Many worlds, despite joining the New Republic, were openly afraid that the government was not strong enough to maintain power.<ref name="TEA" />

Their concerns were realized following the return of Palpatine in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]] during [[Operation Shadow Hand]]. Following the deployment of the world-destroying [[Galaxy Gun]] against several Republic targets, the clone incarnation of Palpatine reclaimed most of the Inner Rim. With the final demise of Palpatine during the [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Onderon]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], much of the region quickly fell back under the New Republic's control. By the end of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|remnants of the Empire]] had been driven into eight barren sectors in the Outer Rim.<ref name="TEC" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Ailon Nova Guard/Legends|Ailon Nova Guard]] joined forces with the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders in conquering several Inner Rim worlds including [[Cona/Legends|Cona]], [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] and [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]].<ref name="GAW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> However, the invaders suffered a substantial setback at the [[Battle of Yag'Dhul (26 ABY)|Battle of Yag'Dhul]]. Following the cessation of conflict in [[30 ABY/Legends|30 ABY]], the Republic's successor state the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] temporarily established its capital on Denon until reconstruction concluded on the devastated galactic capital [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TNEC" />
